text:
emma_cs: @vikram_se heads up — Aurelia Health (vendor-risk) submitted a bespoke security pack. They want: HSM attestation (serial + firmware), raw audit log extract for last 90 days, retention policy proof, and answers to a few SIG-style controls. They also reported an auth/billing spike (401s then a token-usage billing jump) on Wed 09:12 UTC. Deadline: 3 business days (Fri EOD PT). Link to PDF: <https://files.internal/aurelia-risk.pdf> :rotating_light:

vikram_se: I can own the HSM attestation + SIG answers. Need Legal for signing the attestation, and infra to pull the audit export. tagging @leah_ps and @jason_eng.

jason_eng: I pulled infra logs for that window. Quick repro notes: we saw repeated token refresh failures hitting auth-proxy v2.3. Repro (dev):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` then "code":"token_expired" in body. Sample log lines (redacted):
```
2025-10-15T09:12:13Z auth-proxy[pid=231] INFO token_lookup uid=acct-123 method=oauth status=401 reason=expired_token
2025-10-15T09:12:14Z svc-embed[pid=98] WARN retry_loop uid=acct-123 attempts=12 cost_tokens=432
```
Billing note: retries inflated token counts — see delta of +38k tokens between 09:12-09:20 UTC. I'll attach raw CSV extract to the ticket.

leah_ps: For the audit log export, what format does Aurelia want? Typical asks: CSV with columns (timestamp, request_id, principal, action, resource, outcome, region). We can provide a sample 500-line extract (redacted PII). I can run the export if infra gives read access. Also will coordinate on retention policy statement and canonical policy doc.

emma_cs: They specifically asked for HSM firmware level and vendor attestation pdf notarized. Is that something we've pushed from our HSM vendor before?

vikram_se: Yes, we have a vendor-signed attestation from last quarter but it needs an additional dstamp for customer-specific use. I will request an updated attestation with serial numbers and firmware revision. Legal will need to countersign.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4892 and linked SEC-1427 for the SIG/CAIQ responses.

jason_eng: Action items I can do in next 6 hours:
- Attach the exact log CSV for 09:00-10:00 UTC (redacted)
- Export token usage delta and cost impact (tokens & dollars)
- Provide snippet of auth-proxy config (v2.3) showing rotation TTL

vikram_se: Security will prepare CAIQ answers for controls related to key management, logging, and retention. ETA: Thu EOD. HSM attestation request sent to vendor — expect reply in 48 hours.

leah_ps: I'll run the audit export once infra grants the read role (requesting now). Also prepping a short memo on retention policy and export schema for the customer.

emma_cs: Perfect — I'll tell the customer: 1) HSM attestation request in progress (vendor reply expected within 48h + Legal signoff), 2) raw audit extract and sample CSV to follow within 24h, 3) engineering will provide repro logs and a short mitigation plan for the 401/retry spike by EOD today.

security-bot: SEC-1427 updated: assignees=[vikram_se, leah_ps, jason_eng], due_date=2025-10-17T23:59:00-07:00, priority=high.

emma_cs: Thanks team — I'll push the customer the interim update now and pledge the deliverables. If anything blocks Legal or Vendor signatures ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
